content.intro: M4: Financing Just Energy Transition | Chapter 5

content.text: This chapter explores overarching themes critical to sustainable energy finance, such as fostering partnerships between governments, private entities, and civil society. It also emphasizes the integration of gender considerations and regional priorities, illustrating how tailored solutions can address unique challenges while ensuring inclusivity and equity in energy investments.
